t: Reference Implementation Builder - public implementations survey
title: Reference Implementation Builder - public implementations survey
definition: Creates an implementation that demonstrates a defined interface or specification.
description:
Reference Implementation Builder is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Creates an implementation that demonstrates a defined interface or specification. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Reference Implementation Builder. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Reference Implementation Builder. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Reference Implementation Builder capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: ADRs - related Reference Implementation Builder technology
title: ADRs - related Reference Implementation Builder technology
definition: Architecture decision records as memory.
description:
ADRs is not itself a Reference Implementation Builder, but it belongs in this survey because real Reference Implementation Builder work leans on it. Architecture decision records as memory.

In a Reference Implementation Builder build it shows up when the team already lives in its ecosystem. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Reference Implementation Builder practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, ADRs is a solid foundation to build on as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

t: Reference Implementation Builder definition of done - practitioner discipline
title: Reference Implementation Builder definition of done - practitioner discipline
definition: The definition of done discipline for Reference Implementation Builder: creates an implementation that demonstrates a defined interface or specification..
description:
definition of done is the Reference Implementation Builder discipline: Creates an implementation that demonstrates a defined interface or specification. It turns Reference Implementation Builder from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: log every decision with its reason, so the next builder inherits understanding; verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes; keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Impleme
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Impleme
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Implementation Builder from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Reference Implementation Builder from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Reference Implementation Builder needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
